column1: # Tools' own scripts that a shell profile sources from where the tool's installer puts them, outside the
# folders of data/folder-vars.tsv. An account run in fleet mode reads the files a profile sources
# (data/folder-vars.tsv says why) but not these: each is the tool's own code, which sets its
# tool's variable its own way or loads the tool's own plugins, and moves nothing. Matched by name: a sourced path, as the profile writes it, that is the path below or
# ends with / and the path below. One line each, tab separated. After editing, run: bash tools/gen.sh
#   path   the end of the path: plain characters, parts separated by /
#   what   the tool, and the install that puts the script there

nvm installed with Homebrew: its completion, from the same caveat
